meta.source: Ventora brand brief (Oct 2026): navy, peach, off-white, grey, lime; Syne + DM Sans; Lucide.

color.note: Semantic colour roles. Light: off-white canvas, white sheet with hairlines, navy text. Dark: neutral near-black surfaces, warm off-white text; navy survives only on app-icon plates. Peach (attention*) = now / needs your attention / you are here; lime (done*) = done / confirmed. Every text role holds 4.5:1 and every mark role 3:1 on the grounds its note names, in both themes.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind the Sheet; Hub page background; Spine and ContextBar ground. Brand off-white in light, near-black neutral in dark. Light lifted from #EFF0EE to #F2F3F0 in direction B (25 Oct 2026) so white sheets and the navy brand band separate cleanly.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The working surface (Sheet) with its hairline edge: tables, lists, forms, tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs, drawers, toasts, command palette. Lighter than sheet in dark so lift reads without heavy shadow.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas on a Sheet: table header row, read-only and disabled fields, Kbd, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selected list options, the current Spine item, the range inside a date range. Neutral in both themes.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Neutral overlay painted on any interactive surface on hover (rows, quiet buttons, menu items).

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Neutral overlay painted on any interactive surface while pressed.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind Dialog, Drawer and CommandPalette.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, sheet, raised, sunken and selected. Brand navy in light, warm off-white in dark.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table cells that are not the row's name, on every surface. Grey-navy in light, neutral warm grey in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text, helper text, placeholders, timestamps, inactive tab labels, on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast by WCAG).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, table row rules, Sheet and card edges. Structure through lines, not boxes; never a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Section dividers, table header bottom rule, Kbd border, segmented-control track edge.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Boundary of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, toggles, secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on sheet, canvas and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: control-border-hover
tokens.usage: Control boundary on hover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (one per view), checked checkbox/radio/toggle, selected day. Navy in light; warm off-white in dark, so it stays the strongest mark without a navy background.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Fixed brand navy in both themes: marketing moments only. In dark it is never a surface; app icons use the appicon-* tokens.

tokens.name: brand-offwhite
tokens.usage: Fixed brand off-white in both themes: the logo plate in dark, white shapes on app icons.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: Brand zone ground — Hub only: the launcher's bar and greeting band, the sign-in brand panel. Navy in light; a cool near-black in dark (navy is never a surface in dark). Never inside apps. Use through the BrandZone component.

tokens.name: brand-raised
tokens.usage: Chips and controls sitting on brand-surface (the day's sentence chips, the search field in the bar).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-surface: 16.25:1 on navy, 14.66:1 in dark; 14.20:1 on brand-raised.

tokens.name: on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand-surface (the date eyebrow, the day's sentence, the © line): 9.69:1 light, 7.01:1 dark.

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and chip edges on brand-surface. Decoration only.

tokens.name: brand-line-strong
tokens.usage: The chevron pattern on the brand band and panel; hovered chip edges. Decoration only.

tokens.name: brand-control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of controls on brand-surface (the bar's search field): 4.13:1 light, 4.10:1 dark.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Peach fill = now / needs your attention / you are here: the 'now' block, unread count, usage warning fill, active-item marker. Always with on-attention text.

tokens.name: hover-accent
tokens.usage: The 3px peach line under the AppDock card while it is hovered or focused — 'you are here', never at rest. Decoration: lift and shadow carry the hover, the focus ring carries focus (1.87:1 on white is acceptable for that reason).

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an attention fill.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind attention-ink text: attention pills, 'needs your attention' rows, warning banners.

tokens.name: attention-ink
tokens.usage: Text and small icons that mean attention, on sheet, canvas, raised and attention-soft.

tokens.name: attention-mark
tokens.usage: Thin marks that mean now / you are here: the calendar now-line, Spine active bar, StatusDot 'now'. 3:1 on sheet and canvas.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Lime fill = done / confirmed: completed step, confirmed check fill in progress steps. Always with on-done text.

tokens.name: on-done
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a done fill.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind done-ink text: confirmed pills, success toasts.

tokens.name: done-ink
tokens.usage: Text and small icons that mean done / confirmed, on sheet, canvas, raised and done-soft.

tokens.name: done-mark
tokens.usage: Thin marks that mean done: StatusDot 'confirmed', completed progress fill. 3:1 on sheet and canvas.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: destructive button fill, error border on fields, error text.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger-ink text: error banners, failed pills.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error messages and danger icons, on sheet, canvas, raised and danger-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral pills and badges (draft, inactive, the four access states).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the ground colour. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks while loading.

tokens.name: skeleton-highlight
tokens.usage: Moving highlight of the skeleton shimmer.

tokens.name: avatar-bg
tokens.usage: Avatar initials ground; ink on it.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip ground (inverted).

tokens.name: tooltip-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tooltip-bg.

tokens.name: appicon-plate
tokens.usage: App-icon plate — the one place navy stays in dark: brand navy in light, a slightly lifted navy in dark so it reads on near-black.

tokens.name: appicon-edge
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline around the app-icon plate in dark; the shapes carry the meaning.

tokens.name: appicon-shape
tokens.usage: The white shapes of an app icon (brand off-white): 16:1 on the plate in light, 13:1 in dark.

tokens.name: appicon-accent
tokens.usage: The single peach part of each app icon.

tokens.name: appicon-plate-muted
tokens.usage: Plate of an inactive app icon (no access). Neutral grey in both themes.

tokens.name: appicon-shape-muted
tokens.usage: Shapes of an inactive app icon.

tokens.name: appicon-accent-muted
tokens.usage: The peach part of an inactive app icon, turned grey so no inactive app signals attention.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (blue). Assign in this fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Altele'. Validated for colour-blind separation (adjacent ΔE ≥ 10) and ≥ 3:1 on sheet and canvas in both themes. Never peach or lime: those keep their meaning.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (teal). Assign in this fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Altele'. Validated for colour-blind separation (adjacent ΔE ≥ 10) and ≥ 3:1 on sheet and canvas in both themes. Never peach or lime: those keep their meaning.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (violet). Assign in this fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Altele'. Validated for colour-blind separation (adjacent ΔE ≥ 10) and ≥ 3:1 on sheet and canvas in both themes. Never peach or lime: those keep their meaning.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (rose). Assign in this fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Altele'. Validated for colour-blind separation (adjacent ΔE ≥ 10) and ≥ 3:1 on sheet and canvas in both themes. Never peach or lime: those keep their meaning.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (ochre). Assign in this fixed order, never cycled; a 6th series folds into 'Altele'. Validated for colour-blind separation (adjacent ΔE ≥ 10) and ≥ 3:1 on sheet and canvas in both themes. Never peach or lime: those keep their meaning.

tokens.name: chart-compare
tokens.usage: The comparison series: previous period, last year, average. Always grey, always secondary to the series it is compared with; 3:1 on sheet.

tokens.name: chart-now
tokens.usage: The current, still-running period in a time series (this month's bar, today's point). Peach keeps its meaning: now.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines: 1px, solid, recessive.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: The baseline (zero line) of bars and the x axis.

tokens.name: chart-label
tokens.usage: Axis ticks and secondary chart text. Values and legends use ink / ink-secondary, never the series colour.

tokens.name: chart-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp (one hue, navy), step 1 = near zero. Heat grids, intensity.

tokens.name: chart-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 2.

tokens.name: chart-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 3.

tokens.name: chart-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 4.

tokens.name: chart-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 5 = the most.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The statement on the sign-in brand panel; onboarding hero. One per screen. Was 40/44 before direction B.

styles.name: display-hub
styles.usage: Hub only: the greeting on the launcher's brand band and the sign-in title. 32/36 on phones. Inside apps the greeting stays display-l (R-B7).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: The greeting on each app's Today screen. In the Hub (launcher, sign-in) the greeting and title use display-hub.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Brand-led section titles on Hub screens (launcher sections, empty states). Never inside dense app screens.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Azi ai 8 programări, 2 facturi scadente și o cerere de concediu de aprobat.
styles.usage: The day's sentence under the launcher greeting (its links are chips). 15/30 on phones.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The date and business above the launcher greeting, set in capitals (text-transform), on-brand-muted on the band.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles inside a Sheet, panel titles.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Group labels, card titles, table column headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Programarea a fost mutată pe joi, 14:30.
styles.usage: Default text everywhere: table cells, form values, paragraphs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body: the row's name, button labels, selected items.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a name, meta rows, dense lists.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels in dense forms, helper and error text, pills, badges, tooltips.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Key figures (KPIs, usage totals). Always tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense by default; use the step, never an in-between value.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, focus-ring offset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: pill padding, icon gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field-to-field gap; card padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet inner padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet inner padding on desktop; gap between sections in a form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; Hub section spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Sign-in card padding; launcher top spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, Kbd, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, pills' inner chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, cards inside a Sheet.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheet, Dialog, Drawer edge, CommandPalette.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App tiles, the AppDock sheet and cards, the Portal card, app-icon plates. 18px since direction B (was 16px).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, toggles, status dots.

border.note: Stroke widths. Hairlines separate; controls get a slightly heavier stroke so their boundary reads at 3:1.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Hairlines, Sheet and card edges, inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-width-control
tokens.usage: Checkbox, radio, toggle and upload-zone strokes.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring thickness.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

tokens.name: marker-width
tokens.usage: Location markers: Spine active bar, bottom-nav active bar, active table row.

shadow.note: Elevation only for things that float above the Sheet. The Sheet itself is separated by a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Hovered app tiles, sticky table header when scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, date pickers. Also the AppDock sheet that sits over the brand band (direction B: deeper, tighter shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-tile-hover
tokens.usage: The AppDock card opened on hover, floating above the row.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, command palette.

size.note: Fixed dimensions and breakpoints. Touch targets are 44px (touch-target) on coarse pointers and below breakpoint-tablet. CSS media and container queries cannot read custom properties, so bundle.css repeats the breakpoint values; change both together.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls inside dense tables and toolbars (desktop only).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large controls; every control on mobile / coarse pointers.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch devices.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside controls and table cells.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in Spine, ContextBar and empty states' small marks.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: App icons in Spine and bottom nav.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Default DataTable row height.

tokens.name: row-height-dense
tokens.usage: Dense DataTable row height.

tokens.name: spine-width
tokens.usage: Expanded Spine width.

tokens.name: spine-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed Spine (icons only).

tokens.name: contextbar-height
tokens.usage: ContextBar height.

tokens.name: bottomnav-height
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation height (plus safe area).

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Drawer width on desktop; full screen below 640px.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Default Dialog width.

tokens.name: dialog-width-wide
tokens.usage: Wide Dialog (forms with two columns).

tokens.name: app-tile-width
tokens.usage: Minimum AppTile width in the launcher grid.

tokens.name: popover-width
tokens.usage: Business switcher and other list popovers.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Notifications panel and toast stack width.

tokens.name: datepicker-width
tokens.usage: Calendar popover width (7 day columns of control-md).

tokens.name: timepicker-width
tokens.usage: Time-slot list popover width.

tokens.name: menu-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of menus.

tokens.name: menu-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of menus.

tokens.name: cmdk-width
tokens.usage: Command palette width.

tokens.name: popover-max-height
tokens.usage: Max height of listboxes and menus before they scroll.

tokens.name: panel-max-height
tokens.usage: Max height of the notifications panel.

tokens.name: search-width
tokens.usage: ContextBar search field width on desktop.

tokens.name: app-tile-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum AppTile height so tiles align in the grid.

tokens.name: dock-icon
tokens.usage: App icons in the launcher's AppDock row (desktop and tablet).

tokens.name: dock-icon-compact
tokens.usage: The app icon inside the AppDock card opened on hover.

tokens.name: dock-icon-phone
tokens.usage: App icons in the launcher's icon grid on phones.

tokens.name: dock-card-w
tokens.usage: Width of the AppDock card an icon opens into on hover / focus.

tokens.name: dot-size
tokens.usage: Dots inside pills, unread dots, avatar status.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Smallest supported width (phones 360–430px). Below breakpoint-tablet: bottom navigation, full-screen drawers, one-column forms, tables as lists.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet portrait (768–1023px): its own layout — Spine as an icon rail, no bottom nav, drawers as side sheets, two-column forms only where fields are short, search as an icon.

tokens.name: breakpoint-laptop
tokens.usage: Tablet landscape and small laptops (1024–1279px): expanded Spine, full ContextBar search, 3-column tile grids.

tokens.name: breakpoint-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop (1280–1919px): the reference layout; 4-column tile grids, two-pane screens (list + form).

tokens.name: breakpoint-wide
tokens.usage: Wide screens (1920px+): nothing grows past content-max-width; the canvas takes the extra space.

tokens.name: content-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content inside the shell (PageHeader, Sheets, tables), centred on wide screens.

tokens.name: drawer-width-tablet
tokens.usage: Drawer width on tablet portrait — a side sheet, not full screen; leaves the list visible beside it.

tokens.name: schedule-hour-height
tokens.usage: Height of one hour in the calendar grid (Schedule): a 15-minute slot is 16px, a 30-minute appointment shows its time and title.

tokens.name: schedule-gutter
tokens.usage: Width of the hours column in the calendar grid.

tokens.name: chart-bar-max
tokens.usage: Maximum bar/column thickness; leftover band space stays air.

tokens.name: chart-line-width
tokens.usage: Series line thickness (round caps and joins).

tokens.name: chart-marker
tokens.usage: Point and end-dot diameter, with a 2px ring in the surface colour.

tokens.name: chart-gap
tokens.usage: Surface-coloured gap between touching bars and stacked segments.

tokens.name: chart-height
tokens.usage: Default plot height of a dashboard chart; 200px on phones.

tokens.name: stat-value-size
tokens.usage: Value size in a Stat tile (DM Sans 600, tabular figures).

duration.note: Motion is short and functional. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: durations drop to 0.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-intent
tokens.usage: Hover intent: how long the pointer rests on an AppDock icon before its card opens (it closes at once).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toggles, checkbox ticks.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Drawers, dialogs, toasts entering.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Skeleton shimmer step; the AppDock icons coming in on load (40ms apart).

tokens.name: duration-playful
tokens.usage: Small springy moves in the Hub only: the peach hover line, the dock badge.

tokens.name: duration-morph
tokens.usage: An AppDock icon opening into its card and closing back (Hub only).

tokens.name: duration-launch
tokens.usage: AppLaunch: the app's surface growing out of the tapped card, on ease-standard; the whole open takes about 850ms.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for anything that moves or resizes.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving the screen.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A small rebound — Hub only (AppDock entrance and hover card, the icon swelling when tapped). Never inside apps.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, bulk bar.

tokens.name: z-shell
tokens.usage: ContextBar, Spine, bottom nav.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawer and Dialog with their scrim.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, date pickers, tooltips (above overlays).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, always on top.
